tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rtsa gsum tshe zab bla ma bka' brgyad 'dus pa'i sman mchod/1$0000300 kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas 'jig rten dbang*// rdo rje sems dpa' rig 'dzin mchog brgyad la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// tshe dbang mthu yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// rgyal ba kun dngos padma thod phreng rtsal// rdo rje'i sa brnyes grub chen rnam dgu la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// tshe dbang mthu yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// mu rub btsan po mchog gyur bde chen gling*// bka' babs chos bdag rtsa brgyud bla ma la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// tshe dbang mthu yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// padma khrag 'thung rdo rje thod pa rtsal// dpal chen tshom bu sde brgyad 'khor bcas la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// tshe dbang mthu yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// dpal gyi bka' sdod 'bum phrag yangs pa'i 'khor// gnas dang gter srung dam tshig can rnams la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// tshe dbang mthu yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/
zhes pa'ang dbon sprul rin po che'i bka' ltar gu ṇas zhabs tog tu spel ba dge// /
